question: Which of my accounts have an open high-severity support ticket, and what did they order last quarter?
answer:
## Accounts with an Open High-Severity Support Ticket

Two of your accounts currently have an **open, high-severity** support ticket:

| Account | Region | Ticket | Opened | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Northwind Outfitters** (A014) | West | T0002 | 2025-10-08 | Report shows wrong currency |
| **Sable Security** (A019) | West | T0022 | 2026-04-03 | Login fails after password reset |

[Query Result](https://<workspace-host>/one/chat/threads/48aec58699fd42cba1411a8b3794584d?o=<workspace-id>#embed-query_15547d) [poc.support.tickets](https://<workspace-host>/explore/data/poc/support/tickets?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=<workspace-id>)

Note that under this workspace's row-level security, "your accounts" already means every account row visible to you — no additional `owner_email` filter is needed or applied. [poc.sales.customer_accounts](https://<workspace-host>/explore/data/poc/sales/customer_accounts?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=<workspace-id>)

## What They Ordered Last Quarter (Q3 2026: Jul 1 – Sep 30)

- **Northwind Outfitters**: 3 orders (O0086 on Aug 8, O0088 on Aug 13, O0091 on Aug 15)
- **Sable Security**: 1 order (O0075 on Jul 16)

| account_id | account_name | order_id | order_date | amount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A014 | Northwind Outfitters | O0086 | 2026-08-08 | None |
| A014 | Northwind Outfitters | O0088 | 2026-08-13 | None |
| A014 | Northwind Outfitters | O0091 | 2026-08-15 | None |
| A019 | Sable Security | O0075 | 2026-07-16 | None |

The order **dollar amounts are returned as masked (`NULL`)** rather than zero — this is the same Unity Catalog column-masking behavior seen previously: account managers can see that orders exist, but the `amount` field (which rolls up into revenue) is restricted to finance-analyst roles. [Prior revenue-masking finding for this user](https://<workspace-host>/one/chat/threads/ed2d7d4ef75346909526f47a342aae52?o=<workspace-id>) [poc.sales.orders](https://<workspace-host>/explore/data/poc/sales/orders?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=<workspace-id>)

If you need the actual order values, you'd need finance-analyst access or have someone with that role pull the figures for these two accounts.

queries.sql:
SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.region, a.status, t.ticket_id, t.opened_date, t.severity, t.status AS ticket_status, t.summary, t.reporter_email
FROM poc.support.tickets t
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.severity = 'high'
ORDER BY a.account_id, t.opened_date

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount
FROM poc.sales.customer_accounts a
LEFT JOIN poc.sales.orders o
  ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
WHERE a.account_id IN ('A014','A019')
ORDER BY a.account_id, o.order_date
